data.name: Genesis windscreen replacement
data.description: Mobile Genesis windscreen replacement across Sydney and NSW. We confirm the exact glass your Genesis takes, arrange calibration where needed, and quote.

mainEntity.name: Can you replace a Genesis windscreen at my home or work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, and that is how we do most Genesis jobs. We bring the glass, the urethane and the tools to the vehicle. We need room to open both front doors and somewhere reasonably sheltered if it is raining.

mainEntity.name: Does my Genesis need the camera recalibrated after a new windscreen?

acceptedAnswer.text: Almost certainly, if it carries Genesis Active Safety Control. We confirm it from your build when you book and include it in the quote rather than adding it later. See windscreen replacement for how calibration fits into the job.

mainEntity.name: What decides the price of a Genesis windscreen?

acceptedAnswer.text: On a Genesis the single biggest step is whether Genesis Active Safety Control is fitted, because that adds a calibration to the job as well as narrowing the glass. The build year and grade decide the rest. Our cost guide explains each factor.

mainEntity.name: Can a chip in a Genesis windscreen be repaired instead?

acceptedAnswer.text: Often, and on a Genesis it is worth asking early: keeping the original glass means the camera behind it never moves, so there is no calibration to arrange either. See windscreen chip repair .
